name: Canary Mail
install: From canarymail.io or the Mac App Store.
account: Add an IMAP account by hand: host 127.0.0.1, the corpus's port, no encryption. Canary stops at a dialog if the server has no Drafts folder; the corpus has one.
parity: Close the Copilot panel (the AI button) and dismiss the Discover cards, so the reader has the same room as every other client's.
reset: Remove the Bench account and quit Canary.
Press Enter here, then add the account again.

layout.note: 91pt conversation rows; the reader to the right shows the whole conversation. Search is the toolbar field, as-you-type, across every folder. The magnifier toggles the field, so every run starts from a known state: ‹ Back closes it and returns to the inbox, and the magnifier then opens it empty. No select-all, Backspace or Escape, because Canary has single-key shortcuts in the list (e archives).

caveats.text: Measured with the Copilot panel closed and the Discover cards dismissed, so its reader had the same room as everyone else's.
